Privacy and Information Security PoliciesQK Team2022-01-12T21:51:43+00:00
QuickKey Privacy Policy
This Policy applies to all facets of our service accessed via any type of electronic device. By utilizing our service, you
agree to the capture, retention, dissemination and use of your data and information by the following terms. Any
protections, conditions, terms, agreements, and restrictions in this Privacy Policy are considered applicable to DBE, Inc
and the QuickKey Mobile Service.
1. Security
We highly value the security of your information. Whenever you input financial and/or sensitive information (such as
credit card information) on our transactional forms, we use secure socket layer (SSL) to encrypt the information being
transmitted. As another means of protecting the information we receive from you, we follow generally accepted
standards, both during transmission and after it is received. As no method is 100% secure, we cannot promise or
guarantee absolute security of electronic submission or storage. Please direct any security questions or concerns you
may have to our customer support. You are responsible for safeguarding the password you use to access this service
and you agree not to disclose the password to any third party. You are responsible for any activity using your account,
whether or not you authorize that activity. You should immediately notify customer support of any unauthorized use of
your account.
2. Information and Data
Please note that we may collect and store the following information when you access the QuickKey Mobile Services:
Data, Files and Images We collect and store the data and/or files you enter, upload, download, capture, scan or access
with the QuickKey Mobile Services. Log Data We automatically record necessary and/or relevant information from your
Device, its software, and your activity when you use the Services. This may include the Device’s Internet Protocol (“IP”)
address, your mobile carrier, locale preferences, metadata related to your files and images, the web page visited before
you came to our website, browser type, information you search for on our website, identification numbers associated
with your Devices, date and time stamps associated with transactions, system configuration information, and other
interactions with the Services. Cookies All or part of the QuickKey Mobile Services use cookies for user identification.
Cookies must be enabled on your browser for use of our Services. Account Information When an account is created,
QuickKey collects personal information, such as your name, phone number, credit card or other billing information, email
address and home and business postal addresses. In the course of using the Services, we may collect personal
information that can be used to contact or identify you (“Personal Information”). Personal Information is or may be used:
(i) to provide and improve the Services, (ii) to administer your use of the Services, (iii) to better understand your needs
and interests, (iv) to personalize and improve your experience, and (v) to provide or offer software updates and product
announcements. If, at any points, you wish to no longer receive communications from us, please follow the
“unsubscribe” instructions provided in any of those communications, or update your account settings as they relate to
such communications. Geo-Location Information Some Devices allow applications to access real-time location-based
information (for example, GPS). Our mobile apps do not collect such information as of the date this policy went into
effect, but may do so in the future with your consent to improve our Services. Please note that images you upload or
share with QuickKey Mobile may contain recorded location information and we may use this information to optimize your
experience. Also, IP address information from a particular device can sometimes be used to approximate a Device’s
location. Analytics QuickKey Mobile or our associated third party services may also collect additional information by
means of logging and cookies (which can sometimes be correlated with Personal Information). This information is used
to administer, monitor, enhance, and analyze use of the Services as well as to verify users have the authorization
needed for the Services to process their requests.
3. Sharing/Release of Information
Partners and Service Providers Certain third party companies and individuals that we trust may be used to help us
support and/or improve the Services (including but not limited to hosting, data storage, maintenance services, analytics,
payment processing, database management, and improvement of features). These outside parties may have access to

your information only for purposes of performing these tasks on our behalf and under obligations similar to those in this
Privacy Policy. Third-Party Applications With your consent, we may share your information with a third party application,
such as when you choose to access the Services through such an application. QuickKey Mobile is not responsible for
what those parties do with your information, so you should make sure you trust the application and that it has a privacy
policy acceptable to you. Compliance with Laws and Law Enforcement Requests; Protection of QuickKey Mobile’s
Rights We may disclose data or information associated with or collected from your QuickKey Mobile account and/or any
of your devices that have interacted with the Services when we have a good faith belief that disclosure is reasonably
necessary to perform any combination of the following: (a) comply with a law, regulation or compulsory legal request; (b)
protect the safety of any person from death or serious bodily injury; (c) prevent fraud or abuse of QuickKey Mobile or its
users; (d) to protect QuickKey Mobile’s property rights. If we provide your QuickKey Mobile files to a law enforcement
agency as described above, files will be unencrypted prior to being provided to said law enforcement. Transfer of
Ownership In the event that QuickKey Mobile participates in a merger, acquisition, or sale of all or a portion of our
assets, your information may be transferred as part of that transaction. You will be notified (for example, via email and/or
a prominent notice on our website) of any change in control or use of your Personal Information or Files, or if either
become subject to a different Privacy Policy. You will also be notified of choices you may have regarding the information.
Non-private or Non-Personal Information Your non-private, aggregated, or otherwise non-personal information may be
shared with other parties (such as usage statistics of the Services).
FERPA
Our Services comply with all applicable provisions of the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA) (20 U.S.C.
§ 1232g; 34 CFR Part 99). We receive Student Data from School Customers as a “school official” under FERPA and
only process Student Data for educational purposes. In the event we receive a subpoena or judicial order for the
disclosure of education records, we will notify the associated School Customer(s) prior to fulfilling the request in
accordance with §99.31(a)(9). For additional information on FERPA, please visit the U.S. Department of Education’s
Privacy Technical Assistance Center.
Privacy Technical Assistance Center
COPPA
Our Services comply with all applicable provisions of the Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) (15 USC
6501 et seq.) To the extent COPPA applies to information we collect, we process such information for educational
purposes only, at the direction of the partnering School Customer and on the basis of educational institution consent. For
additional information on COPPA and educational institution consent, please refer to the Federal Trade Commission’s
Complying with COPPA: Frequently Asked Questions.
COPPA: Frequently Asked Questions
4. Management, Retention, and Deletion of Your Information
If you are a registered user, you may review, update and correct the Personal Information associated with your account
by changing your “account settings.” If your personally identifiable information changes, or if you no longer wish to use
the Services, you may update it by making the change on your account settings. Please note that we may retain copies
of your account and/or associated information if required by law. The information associated with your account will be
retained for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you service. We may retain and use your
information as necessary to comply with our legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. Within the
constraints of these conditions and any applicable laws, we will delete your information as soon as is feasible upon
request. However, deleting information from our servers may not be instantaneous. Please also note that backed-up
versions of your information might exist for some time period after deletion.
5. Children
Any services that are inherent to or associated with QuickKey Mobile are not intended for persons under the age of 13.
We do not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from children under 13. If a parent or guardian becomes
aware that his or her child has provided us with Personal Information without their consent, he or she should contact us
as soon as possible. If a child under 13 provides us with Personal Information and we become aware, we will take steps
to delete such information from our files as soon as is feasible.
6. Contacting Us

If you have any questions, concerns, or potential misunderstandings about this Privacy Policy, please contact us before
engaging any further with our services at support@quickkeyapp.com.
7. QuickKey is a GDPR compliant SaaS software service. The following are our GDPR-related policies:
QuickKey does not force users to allow cookies in order to use our services or get information.
The following information is available to EU GDPR compliance officers on demand, following proof of identity and
credentials:
Physical location of our data storage servers
Physical location of our compute servers
A list of what personal data is stored
QuickKey does not store credit card information. This information is stored by PayPal, Inc.
You have the right to have all of your personal information removed from QuickKey’s database at any time. Do do so,
please email us and your data will be removed within 72 hours.
8. Changes to this Privacy Policy
The contents of this document may be updated occasionally. If changes are made to this Privacy Policy which we
believe could materially reduce your rights, we will notify you using the contact information that we have available (such
as an email address). There may be other instances in which we notify you of significant or relevant changes to
particular facet(s) of QuickKey Mobile or related DBE, Inc products. If you continue to use the Services after those
changes become effective, you consent to be bound by the revised Privacy Policy.

FERPA and COPPA Compliance StatementQK Team2020-03-11T13:38:19+00:00
FERPA
QuickKey services comply with all applicable provisions of the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA) (20
U.S.C. § 1232g; 34 CFR Part 99). We receive Student Data from School Customers as a “school official” under FERPA
and only process Student Data for educational purposes. In the event we receive a subpoena or judicial order for the
disclosure of education records, we will notify the associated School Customer(s) prior to fulfilling the request in
accordance with §99.31(a)(9). For additional information on FERPA, please visit the U.S. Department of Education’s
Privacy Technical Assistance Center.
COPPA
QuickKey services comply with all applicable provisions of the Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) (15
USC 6501 et seq.) To the extent COPPA applies to information we collect, we process such information for educational
purposes only, at the direction of the partnering School Customer and on the basis of educational institution consent. For
additional information on COPPA and educational institution consent, please refer to the Federal Trade Commission’s
Complying with COPPA: Frequently Asked Questions.
Our COPPA & New York Section 2-D Compliance Policies
QuickKey takes student data privacy seriously. In alignment with U.S. Federal Law and Article 1 – Section 2D of the
Laws of New York, we take the following actions to ensure student data privacy:
QuickKey (QuickKey) limits access to students’ education records to teachers and administrators who are named
employees of the institutions with whom we partner, and only for legitimate educational interests
QuickKey does not use the education records for any purpose other than those explicitly authorized in our contract.
Except for our authorized representatives, to the extent they are carrying out the contract, QuickKey does not disclose
any personally identifiable information to any other party without the prior written consent of the parent or eligible
student; or unless required by statute or court order and the party provides a notice of the disclosure to the department,
district board of education, or institution that provided the information no later than the time the information is disclosed,
unless providing notice of the disclosure is expressly prohibited by the statute or court order.
QuickKey maintains reasonable administrative, technical and physical safeguards to protect the security, confidentiality
and integrity of personally identifiable student information in our custody.
QuickKey uses encryption technology to protect data while in motion or in our custody from unauthorized disclosure
using a technology or methodology specified by the secretary of the United States department of health and human
services in guidance issued under Section 13402(H)(2) of Public Law 111-5.
